variants.prompt: Render a striking, photorealistic portrait of a vivacious young woman in a candlelit chamber, with raven-black hair tousled in effortless waves, expressive emerald eyes sparkling with a sultry invitation, and olive skin radiant in the soft, golden glow of flickering flames. She wears a sheer black lace lingerie set, with delicate straps framing her ample bosom and a garter belt cinching her narrow waist. A diamond choker adorns her graceful throat, while matching stiletto heels elevate her long legs. She reclines on a plush velvet chaise, one hand trailing languidly along her exposed hip as she gazes at the camera with a coy, half-lidded gaze, exuding sensuality and mystery.
